mapper.sql: p.author_id AS authorId, p.author_type AS authorType, CASE WHEN p.author_type = 'PLATFORM' THEN '约场平台' WHEN p.author_type = 'VENUE' THEN (SELECT v.name FROM s_venue v WHERE v.id = p.author_id) ELSE (SELECT u.nickname FROM s_user_account u WHERE u.id = p.author_id) END AS authorName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_post_like l WHERE l.post_id = p.id) AS likeCount, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_post_like l WHERE l.post_id = p.id AND l.user_id = #{userId}) AS liked, CASE WHEN p.author_type = 'USER' AND p.author_id = #{userId} THEN rev.booking_id END AS bookingId,

AND (p.author_type != 'USER' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM s_user_account u WHERE u.id = p.author_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL)) AND (p.author_type != 'USER' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM s_user_block b WHERE (b.blocker_user_id = #{userId} AND b.blocked_user_id = p.author_id) OR (b.blocker_user_id = p.author_id AND b.blocked_user_id = #{userId})))
mapper.select:
SELECT p.id, rev.id AS revisionId, rev.body, rev.sport_type_id AS sportTypeId, st.name AS sportName,
rev.venue_id AS venueId, v.name AS venueName, p.is_official AS isOfficial, p.is_pinned AS isPinned, p.comments_enabled AS commentsEnabled, (p.author_type = 'USER' AND p.author_id = #{userId}) AS isMine, p.content_status AS contentStatus, rev.moderation_status AS moderationStatus, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM s_post p JOIN s_post_revision rev ON rev.id = p.public_revision_id JOIN s_sport_type st ON st.id = rev.sport_type_id LEFT JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = rev.venue_id WHERE p.content_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND rev.moderation_status = 'APPROVED'
AND rev.sport_type_id = #{sportTypeId} AND rev.venue_id = #{venueId} ORDER BY p.is_pinned DESC, p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT p.id, rev.id AS revisionId, rev.body, rev.sport_type_id AS sportTypeId, st.name AS sportName,
rev.venue_id AS venueId, v.name AS venueName, p.is_official AS isOfficial, p.is_pinned AS isPinned, p.comments_enabled AS commentsEnabled, (p.author_type = 'USER' AND p.author_id = #{userId}) AS isMine, p.content_status AS contentStatus, rev.moderation_status AS moderationStatus, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM s_post p JOIN s_post_revision rev ON rev.id = p.public_revision_id JOIN s_sport_type st ON st.id = rev.sport_type_id LEFT JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = rev.venue_id WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.content_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND rev.moderation_status = 'APPROVED'
SELECT * FROM s_post WHERE id = #{postId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.id, rev.id AS revisionId, rev.body, rev.sport_type_id AS sportTypeId, st.name AS sportName,
rev.venue_id AS venueId, v.name AS venueName, p.is_official AS isOfficial, p.is_pinned AS isPinned, p.comments_enabled AS commentsEnabled, TRUE AS isMine, p.content_status AS contentStatus, rev.moderation_status AS moderationStatus, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM s_post p JOIN s_post_revision rev ON rev.id = p.current_revision_id JOIN s_sport_type st ON st.id = rev.sport_type_id LEFT JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = rev.venue_id WHERE p.author_type = 'USER' AND p.author_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT p.id, rev.id AS revisionId, rev.body, rev.sport_type_id AS sportTypeId, st.name AS sportName,
rev.venue_id AS venueId, v.name AS venueName, p.is_official AS isOfficial, p.is_pinned AS isPinned, p.comments_enabled AS commentsEnabled, (p.author_id = #{userId}) AS isMine, p.content_status AS contentStatus, rev.moderation_status AS moderationStatus, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM s_post p JOIN s_post_revision rev ON rev.id = p.public_revision_id JOIN s_sport_type st ON st.id = rev.sport_type_id LEFT JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = rev.venue_id WHERE p.author_type = 'USER' AND p.author_id = #{authorId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.content_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND rev.moderation_status = 'APPROVED'
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE s_post SET is_pinned = FALSE, pinned_slot = NULL WHERE pinned_slot = 1

UPDATE s_post SET is_pinned = #{pinned}, pinned_slot = CASE WHEN #{pinned} THEN 1 ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{postId} AND author_type = 'PLATFORM' AND content_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_post WHERE id = #{postId} AND author_type = 'USER' AND author_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE s_post SET current_revision_id = #{revisionId}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE s_post SET public_revision_id = #{revisionId}, content_status = CASE WHEN content_status = 'HIDDEN' THEN 'HIDDEN' ELSE 'PUBLISHED' END, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{postId} AND current_revision_id = #{revisionId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE s_post p JOIN s_post_revision r ON r.post_id = p.id SET p.public_revision_id = r.id, p.content_status = CASE WHEN p.content_status = 'HIDDEN' THEN 'HIDDEN' ELSE 'PUBLISHED' END, p.updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE r.id = #{revisionId} AND p.current_revision_id = r.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE s_post SET content_status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{postId} AND author_type = 'USER' AND author_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT 'POST' AS contentType, NULL AS replyId, p.id AS reviewId, rev.id AS revisionId, rev.venue_id AS venueId, v.name AS venueName, rev.body, pub.body AS publicBody, p.content_status AS contentStatus, rev.moderation_status AS moderationStatus, NULL AS overallScore, rev.created_at AS submittedAt FROM s_post p JOIN s_post_revision rev ON rev.id = p.current_revision_id LEFT JOIN s_post_revision pub ON pub.id = p.public_revision_id LEFT JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = rev.venue_id WHERE (rev.moderation_status = 'PENDING' OR p.content_status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'HIDDEN')) AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY rev.moderation_status DESC, rev.created_at ASC, rev.id ASC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE s_post_revision SET moderation_status = #{status} WHERE id = #{revisionId} AND moderation_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE s_post SET content_status = #{status}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE s_post SET content_status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_content_moderation_log (content_type, content_id, revision_id, action, reason, operator_admin_id) VALUES ('POST', #{postId}, #{revisionId}, #{action}, #{reason}, #{operatorAdminId})
